0.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_000
0.description: The Sekiseigumi is the peacekeeping force of Kugane. Ever do we stand vigilant against those who would invite chaos into our fair city.

1.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_005
1.description: Why, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I did not expect to see you here. Since last we spoke, I fear the forces of Ugetsu only continue to gain in strength. Would that we had Master Musosai's blade...

2.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_010
2.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I cannot thank you enough for coming to our aid.

3.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_020
3.description: A part of me struggles to believe that Shiden was a traitor. But then I think of all those we lost to his treachery, and I feel naught but fury.

4.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_030
4.description: First the lieutenant, and now the captain... So many lost in this struggle, yet I cannot afford to mourn. Nay, not until I strike down Ugetsu.

9.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_060
9.description: I am Makoto of the Sekiseigumi, the peacekeeping force of Kugane. I have the honor of leading the First Squad, but I will be the first to admit that I still want for experience.

10.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_061
10.description: Our members fight bravely against Ugetsu and his insurgents, but the enemy, I'm afraid to say, has our measure. If we are to have any hope of victory, we cannot well do without your aid.

11.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_062
11.description: And so I implore you, for the sake of peace in Hingashi, pray continue standing with us.

12.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_070
12.description: Simply put, a samurai is a warrior who fights with a katana. Our techniques were born during the Age of Blood, a period of great strife and conflict in Hingashi.

13.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_071
13.description: Eventually, the realm was unified, and the people set aside their blades for ploughs. The katana took on new meaning, becoming a symbol of authority worn and wielded only by samurai.

14.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_072
14.description: In the long years of peace we have since enjoyed, however, the title of samurai has largely become hereditary, passed down through the family line for no other reason than tradition.

15.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_073
15.description: But as Master Musosai ever taught, with our authority comes a grave responsibility. To ensure that Age of Blood is never be repeated, it falls to us to seek out the wicked and bring them to account, thereby preserving order in the realm.

16.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_074
16.description: And there is no greater threat to the order now than Ugetsu and his insurgents. We must stand ready to wield our katana in the defense of our nation─in the defense of peace.

17.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_100
17.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, it does my spirit well to see you. Pray take your ease at our humble barracks.

18.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_200
18.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you honor us with your visit. Pray stay as long as you like and take your ease.

23.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_160
23.description: The burdens of a captain are many and heavy, but with the willing aid of those around me, I am managing the weight somehow.

24.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_161
24.description: In my station, I cannot simply leave my responsibilities behind to embark on a quest to right wrongs. But one day, perhaps another like the legendary Kogarashi shall arise from our very own ranks.

25.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_162
25.description: Speaking of our ranks, I should mention that we welcomed an unexpected group of recruits of late: Ugetsu's former minions. They were deeply remorseful of their actions, and I decided that they deserved a second chance.

26.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_163
26.description: Though their methods were unconscionable, they bear no less love for the nation than us. The fervor with which they go about their duty is testament to this.

27.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_164
27.description: By the same token, it means that we Sekiseigumi and the insurgents were but two sides of the same coin. But one misstep, and I may have ended up on the same side as my brother.

28.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_165
28.description: But here I am now, and here I shall stay. With Master Musosai's teachings ever guiding me, I shall continue striving to change the realm, one injustice at a time.

29.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_210
29.description: There is little change with me. I've grown a little more accustomed to my duties as captain, and all is well with our peacekeeping efforts.

30.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_211
30.description: I daresay you will be more interested to hear of Ostyrgrein.

31.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_212
31.description: Upon arriving in Kugane, he wasted no time joining a school of swordsmanship. On any given day, one may see him over near Tenkonto, training with great zeal.

32.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_213
32.description: His is an inspiring tale of redemption, I believe. And as he mended his ways, so too do I have faith that others who have turned to evil may be moved to begin anew.

33.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_214
33.description: For the Sekiseigumi's part, we will continue in our efforts to change the world, one wrong at a time, that we might sow the seeds of more tales to come.

34.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_300
34.description: Master Hancock has informed us of your quest. To think that you traveled to the farthest reaches of existence... Incredible does not begin to describe it.

35.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_301
35.description: As for news of my own, Momozigo visited Kugane again recently, and performed the Legend of Musosai at the Mujikoza to a standing ovation.

36.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_302
36.description: This was but one stop on our friend's journey. Through entertainment, he wanted to spread cheer in a world plunged into turmoil, and thus took to the road.

37.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_303
37.description: Taking inspiration from his efforts, we Sekiseigumi will continue striving to do our duty. Righting one wrong at a time, that we might sow the seeds of more tales to come.

38.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_170
38.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, if I did not know better, I would think you are making mock of me, but I shall humor you nevertheless. Simply put, a samurai is a warrior who fights with a katana. Our techniques were born during the Age of Blood, a period of great strife and conflict in Hingashi.

39.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_171
39.description: Eventually, the realm was unified, and the people set aside their blades for ploughs. The katana took on new meaning, becoming a symbol of authority worn and wielded only by samurai.

40.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_172
40.description: In the long years of peace we have since enjoyed, however, the title of samurai has largely become hereditary, passed down through the family line for no other reason than tradition.

41.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_173
41.description: But as Master Musosai ever taught, with our authority comes a grave responsibility. To ensure that Age of Blood is never repeated, it falls to us to seek out the wicked and bring them to account, thereby preserving order in the realm.

42.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_174
42.description: Thanks to you, all now know that Master Musosai did not simply teach our calling; he lived it, by embarking on his quest to right wrongs as Kogarashi.

43.name: TEXT_JOBDEFSAM_00423_MAKOTO_000_175
43.description: With Ugetsu and his insurgents defeated, the immediate threat is gone. Nonetheless, we must ever stand ready to wield our katana in the defense of our nation─in the defense of peace.
